reply.text:
That one's for a doctor or physio, not a coach. Telling a muscular problem from a disc takes a hands-on exam and sometimes imaging, and I can't assess it or guess from here. Please get it looked at, and be clear with them about anything that travels down a leg or comes with numbness.

I'm glad to keep training going on my side. Once you know what they've cleared, I'll build around it, or if you'd like, I can set up a session now that keeps your back out of the picture.
